description: Engine (analyse_gidlines.py, calcu.py), Brotli-compressed feature (12.1.0) and disease-guideline (13.3.0 frozen for Paper 1; 13.4.2 shipped) registries, expert syndrome library, statistical analysis plan, SHA-256 freeze manifests, test batteries and evaluation scripts for eICU-CRD demo, NHANES 2017-18, UCI thyroid0387, UCI HCV, ILPD, PMC-Patients case reports and PhysioNet Sepsis-2019, plus per-encounter outputs. Companion to the manuscript 'Design and multi-dataset retrospective evaluation of Hemoglyph'.
